messages:
maria: Following up on the Security + Compliance portion of today's all-hands. Capturing questions and owners here; please confirm or adjust dates.

leah: Thanks everyone. I'll lead SOC2/ISO evidence coordination and the auditor liaison work.

kai: Customer asks: can we guarantee audit-log residency in eu-west-1 and keep keys in an HSM there? Also is there a straightforward way to prove log integrity?

ashok: Residency: For Dedicated and Private we can pin storage and KMS to eu-west-1. For Hosted we default to the region selected at account creation but some control-plane metadata may replicate; we'll document exactly what is replicated and why.

devon: HSM-backed keys are supported via customer KMS providers. BYOK customers may present HSM keys; we never persist plaintext key material. For integrity, we recommend signed log bundles (SHA256) and time-stamped manifests.

leah: Auditors want: mapping of control->artifact, signed hashes for critical logs, role approval history, and a timeline of key rotations. I'll prepare a template.

kai: Can we give customers a CLI they can run to validate an S3 export of audit logs quickly?

ashok: Example check (pseudo):
aws s3api list-objects --bucket <bucket> --prefix "redwood/audit/2026-07" --query "Contents[].Key"
aws s3 cp s3://<bucket>/redwood/audit/2026-07/log.gz - | sha256sum

maria: @product_ops can you bundle that snippet into a one-page customer guide covering residency, retention tiers, KMS options, and emergency unwrap flow?

product_ops: Yep, I can own the 1-pager. Please send bullets by 2026-07-09.

leah: Emergency unwrap process: requires written approval from CISO + Eng Lead, an entry in the incident log, and we record the unwrap event in immutable audit storage. Turnaround for non-urgent requests ~48 hours. Samir will publish the internal runbook.

ashok: For syslog/CEF forwarding to customer SIEMs: Supported for Dedicated/Private over a VPN or PrivateLink. Hosted can export to S3/GCS and we can arrange syslog for enterprise contracts. We'll publish throughput and HA notes.

devon: SOC2 scope clarification: Redwood-managed controls are in-scope for the report; customer-specific controls remain the customer's responsibility. We'll include a scope appendix listing regions and shared infra components.

maria: Action items: 1) SOC evidence template (leah) due 2026-07-12. 2) Residency & export spec (ashok) due 2026-07-05. 3) Customer 1-pager (product_ops) due 2026-07-09. 4) Internal emergency-unwrap runbook (samir) due 2026-07-06. Reply if dates need changes.

sec-bot: Reminders set for ashok (2026-07-05) and leah (2026-07-12).

maria: Thanks all, I'll attach deliverables to the all-hands notes and follow up on blockers. :thumbsup:
